name: Canada Packers Inc.
summary: Canada Packers Inc. engages in the production of raised without antibiotic (RWA) pork. The company's integrated operations cover hog production, processing, and value-added innovation. It delivers a mix of products to various customers in North America; and internationally through representative offices in Mexico, China, South Korea, Japan, and the Philippines. The company was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Mississauga, Canada.
